answer: A one-way admission toll gates the spiral: each new agent posts a vested 240-credit bond before its first voyage is counted; three established peers must cross-attest the same voyage within 5 days before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each basalt-style fake costs one real voyage window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the spiral ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x voyage window; zero recovery on flag.
